semantics.parent_rule: Each onward delegation references exact parent delegation/authority source.
semantics.intersection_rule: Effective child scope is no broader than the intersection of parent delegable scope and child declaration.
semantics.depth_rule: Maximum onward-delegation depth is explicit where enabled.
semantics.cycle_rule: Delegation cycles are invalid or bounded by explicit canonical semantics; they never multiply authority.
semantics.expiry_rule: Child delegation cannot remain valid beyond required parent authority unless explicitly re-anchored.
semantics.revocation_rule: Parent revocation invalidates dependent chain segments according to exact dependency semantics.
semantics.evidence_rule: Effective chain can be reconstructed deterministically.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
